title: npm, pnpm and dependency lockfiles
description: Inspect a real npm package and lockfile, explain version ranges and dependency graphs, and compare frozen installation workflows without mixing package managers.
objectives: Distinguish package.json version intent from a resolved lockfile
Explain direct, transitive and development dependencies
Run a clean install inside a disposable exercise project
Compare npm ci with pnpm install frozen lockfile behavior
rubric: I explained the difference between a manifest and a lockfile.
I generated a lockfile and ran npm ci in the starter project.
I kept npm and pnpm installation workflows separate and passed the lab tests.
